name: Sinopep-Allsino Bio Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Sinopep-Allsino Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd., a biomedical company, engages in the research and development, production, and sale of peptides, oligonucleotides, and small molecule drugs in China. The company offers Peptide CDMO Services,GMP oligo, full-time equivalent, discovery, generic APIs, and formulation services. It is also involved in professional technical services. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
